svg.text: TV / MAKEUP CABINET v9 | build order | exploded reference module; mirror/repeat as stated below
BEDROOM WORKSHOP | mm | verify stock and purchased hardware before cutting | revision 2026-11-15
1. Assemble each Bottom between Sides, then Back and square Front.
2. Build three tower drawers, two wardrobe drawers and the single makeup drawer.
3. Fit the six retained 400 mm runner pairs using the selected runner instructions.
4. Adjust fronts to the modelled gaps. Check movement through the plywood channels.
